title: Contact Vertical Life | The Atrium near Carmel
description: Call, email or visit Vertical Life at the Atrium, 10330 N Meridian St, Suite 300, Indianapolis, near Carmel. Plan a tour or ask about partnering with us.

blocks.headline: We'd love to hear from you
blocks.body: Call, email or come see the Atrium. Whether you're looking for a desk, a room or a way to partner with us, here's how to reach the team at Vertical Life.

items.title: Call us
items.body:
[317-779-2497](tel:3177792497)

Questions about packages, rooms or our ecosystem? Give us a call.

items.title: Email us
items.body:
[hello@thevertical.life](mailto:hello@thevertical.life)

Send us a note and someone from the team will get back to you.

items.title: Find the Atrium
items.body:
10330 N Meridian St, Suite 300, Indianapolis, IN 46290

On N Meridian near Carmel.

blocks.heading: Visiting the Atrium
blocks.body:
The Atrium is Vertical Life's physical home: coworking, dedicated desks and private offices for Kingdom-minded businesses, nonprofits and community members, plus meeting rooms, a production studio and a performance space.

The best way to see it is a tour. Fill out the short form on the [visit page](/visit) and we'll take it from there.

items.title: Partner with us
items.body: Interested in becoming an organizational partner or supporting the mission? Start with the get involved form.

items.title: Tour the Atrium
items.body: See the space, meet a few people and get the pricing sheet by email.

items.title: Book a room
items.body: Meeting rooms, the production studio and the performance space are open to anyone at public rates.

items.title: Host an event
items.body: The production studio and performance space are open for bookings now. Our event space is coming soon, opening for bookings in early 2027.

blocks.heading: Come see the Atrium
blocks.body: Fill out one short form. We'll email the pricing sheet, text you within 2 hours and send a link to book your tour.
